title: We should create a distribution platform for AI games...And do it proudly.
author: ZeColorOfPomegranate
selftext:
Good evening all,

We should create a commercial service for AI games. For AI DEV and by AI DEV.

There could be partnerships and joint ventures with LLM big names.

But furthermore, games could be embedded with editable features, connected with major commercial AI. A Visual plugin why not...

So DEVs would not adjudicated by a bunch of hysterical anti, or curated in nepotism on GOG. It would be simpler than Steam to put a game on the market.

I have many ideas in that direction...

What do you think about it ?

comments.author: Dizzy-Brilliant2745
comments.body: Great way to have a platform with 99% people posting games and no players

replies.author: ZeColorOfPomegranate
replies.body: ...If it can avoid the "Itch.io Syndrom", meaning really games and not a shit load of "kawai" humanistic crap. Few game changers could draw curious crowds. Perhaps...

replies.author: Valdaraak
replies.body: On the other hand, Itch is a fantastic resource for assets and tools so the games on there are really secondary.

replies.author: OldLead4716
replies.body: Hmm seems whoever makes this if they even charge 1 it'll be a gold mine think of steam right now with every AI game thinking they gonna make it.

comments.author: LowerMiddleClassMan
comments.body: If your game is as bad as your ideas, you’re going to be a scapegoating “anti’s” for why you don’t get back your $100 steam listing fee.

replies.author: ZeColorOfPomegranate
replies.body: I don't act to get the approval of those crazy marxists, so called Anti.

replies.author: Baraga91
replies.body:
u/LowerMiddleClassMan looks like you were right on the money...

Crazy Marxists, the lot of em 😂

replies.author: LowerMiddleClassMan
replies.body: It’s sardonic buddy.  I’m solidly middle class and make 300k a year

replies.author: Valdaraak
replies.body: Way to let the mask drop there.

comments.author: Square-Yam-3772
comments.body: there are a couple platforms already. I used to get asked to upload my games onto those platforms. I don't know if they ever catch on.

comments.author: Haster
comments.body: What the market really needs is a platform that will sell games that use llm in the gameplay and let players authenticate with openai's new 'bring your tokens' platform.

comments.author: Patient-Sprinkles920
comments.body: Google Play and Steam do seem to be where games go to die. I would love an alternative.

replies.author: Neither-Upstairs
replies.body: Google Play and Steam are where the players are

comments.author: SeasawPhilosopher
comments.body: In a year no one will care about games being made with AI because every studio will have adopted AI workflow to reduce costs. The important thing is how good a game is not how it was made, we’re just in a transition period but I doubt it will last long.

replies.author: ZeColorOfPomegranate
replies.body: Amen, I agree. AI is a powertool. The best one we had probably.

replies.author: Neither-Upstairs
replies.body: You’re acting like this is not already here lol

comments.author: amirati91
comments.body:
That would be to turn the tool into the protagonist, not the game.

If the game is not a protagonist, why do it?

Let's create a store just for games made in Godot. Only for games made with Dell computer. Only made with PCs whose card is a Ryzen 7.

It is nonsense.

comments.author: zayelion
comments.body: I'm down. Let's start a company. Build each of steams features.
